name: s3m-monorepo
description: SuperMap S3M 渲染库 monorepo：packages/s3m-three（three.js 渲染内核，宿主无关）+ packages/s3m-maplibre（MapLibre / Mapbox 适配层）

scripts.build: bun run build:three && bun run build:maplibre && bun run build:docs
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd packages/s3m-three clean && bun run --cwd packages/s3m-maplibre clean
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/s3m-three typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/s3m-maplibre typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && node tools/parse-sample.mjs && node tools/test-batch-texmatrix.mjs && node tools/test-texture-format.mjs && node tools/test-ortho.mjs && node tools/test-instanced.mjs && node tools/test-regressions.mjs && node tools/test-parser.mjs && node tools/test-new-features.mjs
scripts.test:meshopt: bun run build:three && node tools/meshopt-check.mjs --preset shenyin
